# DBSCAN / GMM model

`amgeo_sd.clustering` — Cluster the raw echoes of each beam.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`box_cox_abs`](#box_cox_abs) | Box-Cox transform of ``\|values\|`` (floor 1e-5); non-finite results and constant input become 0. |
| [`cluster_beam`](#cluster_beam) | Cluster labels of the echoes of one beam (``df`` has ``slist``, ``scnum`` and, for GMM, ``v``). |
| [`cluster_scans`](#cluster_scans) | Add ``cluster_tag`` and ``gflg_ribiero`` to the echoes of ``scans`` (modified in place and returned). |
| [`gmm_components`](#gmm_components) | Gaussian-mixture component of every echo (all 0 when the beam has fewer than ``n_data_th`` echoes). |
| [`parse_gmm_beams`](#parse_gmm_beams) | Beams that get the Gaussian-mixture step: ``""`` none, ``"A"`` all, ``"T"`` the themis beam, ``"3,7"`` a list. |

## `box_cox_abs`

```python
box_cox_abs(values: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
```

Box-Cox transform of ``|values|`` (floor 1e-5); non-finite results and constant input become 0.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | ndarray | required | Velocities [m/s]; only their magnitude is used. |

**Returns**

- *ndarray* — The transformed values, same length as ``values``.

## `cluster_beam`

```python
cluster_beam(df: pd.DataFrame, p: Dbscan, use_gmm: bool = False, themis: bool = False) -> np.ndarray
```

Cluster labels of the echoes of one beam (``df`` has ``slist``, ``scnum`` and, for GMM, ``v``).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `df` | pandas.DataFrame | required | Echoes of one beam and channel with the columns ``slist`` (range gate), ``scnum`` (scan number) and, when ``use_gmm``, ``v`` (velocity). |
| `p` | Dbscan | required | Settings; uses ``eps``, ``eps_g``, ``eps_s``, ``min_samples``, ``tb_mult`` and, for GMM, ``n_clusters``, ``cov`` and ``n_data_th``. |
| `use_gmm` | bool | `False` | Split the echoes into velocity components first and cluster inside each. |
| `themis` | bool | `False` | The beam is the themis special beam: ``min_samples`` is multiplied by ``tb_mult`` because it is sounded more often. |

**Returns**

- *ndarray of int* — One label per row of ``df``; ``-1`` is noise. With GMM the labels of different components do not collide.

## `cluster_scans`

```python
cluster_scans(scans: Sequence[Scan], scan_info: dict, p: Dbscan) -> Sequence[Scan]
```

Add ``cluster_tag`` and ``gflg_ribiero`` to the echoes of ``scans`` (modified in place and returned).

Each (channel, beam) is clustered on its own in the plane (range gate / ``eps_g``, scan number / ``eps_s``), optionally
after splitting its velocities into Gaussian-mixture components; the cluster's speed and lifetime then decide
ionospheric or ground scatter ([`ribiero_flags`](scatter.md#ribiero_flags)). Cluster labels are unique within a beam only.
No echo is removed or changed.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scans` | sequence of Scan | required | Raw (unfiltered) scans; ``Beam.extra`` is modified in place. |
| `scan_info` | dict | required | Result of [`estimate_scan_info`](io.md#estimate_scan_info) (``s_mode``, ``t_beam``); selects the themis special beam. |
| `p` | Dbscan | required | Settings; uses ``eps``, ``eps_g``, ``eps_s``, ``min_samples``, ``tb_mult``, ``gmm``, ``n_clusters``, ``cov``, ``n_data_th``, ``velocity_threshold`` and ``min_gate``. See the [parameter reference](../PARAMETERS.md). |

**Returns**

- *sequence of Scan* — The same scans, each beam with ``cluster_tag`` (-1 noise) and ``gflg_ribiero`` (-1 unclassified, 0 ionospheric, 1 ground) in ``extra``.

## `gmm_components`

```python
gmm_components(velocity: np.ndarray, p: Dbscan) -> np.ndarray
```

Gaussian-mixture component of every echo (all 0 when the beam has fewer than ``n_data_th`` echoes).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `velocity` | ndarray | required | Velocities [m/s] of the echoes of one beam; the mixture is fitted to the Box-Cox transform of their magnitude. |
| `p` | Dbscan | required | Settings; uses ``n_clusters`` (components), ``cov`` (covariance type) and ``n_data_th`` (minimum number of echoes for the fit). |

**Returns**

- *ndarray of int* — Component number (0 to ``n_clusters - 1``) of every echo.

## `parse_gmm_beams`

```python
parse_gmm_beams(spec: str, beams: Sequence[int], t_beam: int = -1) -> set[int]
```

Beams that get the Gaussian-mixture step: ``""`` none, ``"A"`` all, ``"T"`` the themis beam, ``"3,7"`` a list.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec` | str | required | The ``[dbscan] gmm`` setting. |
| `beams` | sequence of int | required | Beam numbers present in the data (used by ``"A"``). |
| `t_beam` | int | `-1` | Themis special beam number, ``-1`` if none (used by ``"T"``). |

**Returns**

- *set of int* — The selected beam numbers.
